Observed patterns describe spending allocation, timing, and purchase concentration. They are descriptive, not predictions of intent or performance.
Historical pages can display a player's current ESPN NFL affiliation rather than the club at the time of the old draft. Values here reproduce ESPN's displayed abbreviation.
